name: templio
description: 模板宝 - PPT/Word 模板库小程序（服务端 + Web 管理端 + 微信小程序 + 桌面批处理 CLI）

scripts.build: npm run build -w @templio/shared && npm run build -w @templio/desktop-cli && npm run build -w @templio/api && npm run build -w @templio/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @templio/shared && npm run typecheck -w @templio/shared && npm run typecheck -w @templio/desktop-cli && npm run typecheck -w @templio/api && npm run typecheck -w @templio/admin
scripts.doctor: npm run build -w @templio/shared && npm run doctor -w @templio/desktop-cli
scripts.fixtures: npm run build -w @templio/shared && npm run fixtures -w @templio/desktop-cli --
scripts.render: npm run build -w @templio/shared && npm run render -w @templio/desktop-cli --
scripts.status: npm run build -w @templio/shared && npm run status -w @templio/desktop-cli --
